name: Shintomi (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Shintomi town emblem in yellow: a stylised device of two interlocking hooked strokes with pointed ends.
history: Municipal flag of Shintomi, a town in Miyazaki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 1962.

features.role: Shintomi town emblem — a stylised device of two interlocking hooked strokes with pointed ends
